exposure: mode of delivery (VBAC attempt vs. repeat cesarean section)
cohort: The study included 127 women with a history of one or more cesarean deliveries at Anugrah Narayan Magadh Medical College and Hospital, Gaya, from August 2023 to July 2024.
finding: VBAC attempts demonstrated a 70.7% success rate and were associated with lower maternal morbidity compared to repeat cesarean sections, with generally favorable fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: VBAC is associated with lower maternal morbidity compared to repeat cesarean sections, making it a viable option for many women.
